caption: The drawing depicts three views of an oval-shaped, light blue glass bottle on a cream-colored background. The main, centrally positioned view shows the front of the bottle, which features an embossed image of a bearded man in profile, accompanied by the embossed text "NEW JERSEY BRIDGETON" encircling the portrait. To the upper left is a smaller frontal view of the same bottle, displaying an embossed image of a sailing ship at sea within the oval. In the upper right, a side view of the bottle highlights its flattened, elongated shape and subtle ridges along its sides. The bottle has a narrow cylindrical neck and a small lip at the top. There is a faint horizontal scale line to the lower left of the main bottle image. The objects are uniformly colored in various shades of blue, using highlights and shadows to indicate transparency and the reflective quality of glass.
title: Flask
